title: macOS kernel
summary: The kernel. High CPU often means macOS is throttling to manage heat, not that the kernel is busy.

title: Window server
summary: Draws every window and the display. Quitting it logs you out.

title: Launch daemon manager
summary: The first process; starts and supervises every other service.

title: Unified logging
summary: Collects system and app log messages. Spikes with chatty apps or debug logging.

title: Spotlight indexing
summary: Indexes files for Spotlight search. High disk and CPU during initial indexing or after large file changes.

title: iCloud Drive sync
summary: Syncs iCloud Drive documents. Busy after large changes or on first sign-in.

title: CloudKit daemon
summary: Syncs app data with iCloud on behalf of apps.

title: Background transfers
summary: Runs downloads and uploads for apps, such as App Store and iCloud.

title: Duet activity scheduler
summary: Decides when background tasks run based on power and usage.

title: Power management
summary: Handles sleep, wake and battery policy.

title: Core Audio
summary: Audio server. Restarts automatically if stopped, and audio drops briefly.

title: Bluetooth daemon
summary: Manages Bluetooth devices and connections.

title: Sharing services
summary: AirDrop, Handoff and other sharing features.

title: Device continuity
summary: Links nearby Apple devices for Continuity features.

title: Apple ID messaging
summary: Delivers iMessage and FaceTime signalling.

title: Messages storage
summary: Stores Messages history for the current user.

title: Photos analysis
summary: Scans the Photos library for faces and scenes. Heavy after importing many photos.

title: Time Machine
summary: Runs Time Machine backups. Heavy disk use while a backup is running.

title: Privacy permissions
summary: Enforces and stores privacy permissions.

title: Security initialization
summary: Applies the sandbox and code signing policy when apps launch.

title: System monitor service
summary: Provides process statistics to Activity Monitor and similar tools.

title: Diagnostics
summary: Gathers diagnostic reports after a hang or a manual request.

title: Docker Desktop
summary: Container engine and its Linux virtual machine. Memory is reserved for the VM.

title: OrbStack
summary: Container and Linux machine runtime.

title: Xcode
summary: Apple's IDE and its build services. Heavy during builds and indexing.

title: Swift language service
summary: Code completion and indexing for Swift in Xcode and editors.

title: Node.js
summary: JavaScript runtime. Often runs dev servers, bundlers and tools.

title: Python
summary: Python interpreter running a script or tool.

title: Electron app
summary: Chromium-based app shell. Helpers split rendering, GPU and utility work.

title: Safari web content
summary: Web pages and their networking and GPU helpers, one per tab or site.

title: Google Chrome
summary: Chromium browser. Each tab, extension and GPU task runs in its own helper.

title: Finder
summary: File manager and desktop. Restarts automatically if quit.

title: Dock
summary: Dock, Mission Control and Spaces. Restarts automatically if quit.

title: Preferences daemon
summary: Serves app preferences. Never needs to be quit.

title: Certificate trust
summary: Evaluates certificates and revocation for apps and the system.

title: Gatekeeper policy
summary: Checks apps against Gatekeeper and notarization rules on first launch.

title: XProtect
summary: Apple's built-in malware detection and remediation.
